title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 045
review_goal: Differentiate bill, black board, and bowl variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Receipt sheet with two horizontal text lines and a zigzag bottom edge
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a single receipt page with a torn zigzag bottom edge.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the stacked receipt when a second page should show behind the front sheet.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows one receipt page with two lines and one torn lower edge.

items.depicts_observation: Receipt sheet with two text lines and a second page behind the left side
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a receipt shape with a second sheet peeking from behind.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the single receipt when no second page should appear behind the front sheet.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds a second page behind the first receipt while keeping the torn lower edge.

items.depicts_observation: Classroom blackboard on a base rail with one centered eraser block
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a classroom board resting on a base rail with an eraser.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the hanging board when the top hook and text lines should be visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a wide board on a base line with one small block resting near the center.

items.depicts_observation: Hanging board with a top hook and two short text lines
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a hanging board or sign with short text lines inside.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the classroom blackboard on a base when the lower rail should be visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds a top hook and two short horizontal lines inside the board.

items.depicts_observation: Round serving bowl with a half circle rim above a thick foot
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a plain serving bowl without steam or extra marks above it.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the hot bowl when steam curls should rise over the rim.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows only the bowl body and foot with no steam above it.
